tasks.short: Compile and record medical charts, reports and correspondence.

steps.what: Compile reports and correspondence for the medical chart.

loop.input: Loose reports and correspondence plus the chart index
loop.output: Pages proposed for this chart, and pages that do not match the patient
loop.check: Secretary checks identity on every proposed page
loop.stop: One pass; a page with the wrong identity is excluded
loop.why_not_simpler: Pages arrive under different names and layouts

steps.what: Put the pages in chart order and type the missing lines.
Check the patient's identity on every page.
File the compiled chart in the record.
Send correspondence that was requested outside the practice.

tasks.design: Loose reports and correspondence are proposed for one chart, and the secretary checks the identity on every page before the chart is filed. Correspondence that leaves the practice is sent only after that check. Native chart order is tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pages were gathered from trays and typed into the chart with the patient checked by eye at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: An index can gather pages that already name the patient. Identity on a scanned page is still a person.
tasks.still_hard: Married names, twin records, and correspondence that should not leave.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary sees a page that belongs to someone else.
tasks.altitude: Compiling stays on the week as checking, not as hunting trays. The secretary can exclude a page.

reach.task: Assemble a file from loose documents
reach.learn: How they keep a stray page out of the wrong file

evidence.claim: Pages that already carry an identifier can be gathered into a chart. A person still checks identity before filing.
The compiled chart is part of the medical file under the WGBO.
Health data sent outside the practice is special-category data under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary. Boundary: from loose pages to a filed chart or a sent letter. Writing the clinical report is a different task.
Structured fields are patient identifier, document date and document type. Authors produce the pages. Fallback: a page without a clear identity is not filed.
Test native chart assembly before custom code. Outbound correspondence uses the same identity check.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers document types.
unknowns: Whether incoming pages already carry a patient identifier.
What share of correspondence actually leaves the practice.
research_questions: How often does a bundle contain a page for the wrong patient?

already_counted.description: Type missing lines and order the chart

incremental.description: Update document types used in chart assembly

approvals.approved_version: correspondence version whose pages passed the identity check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: pages have no identifier, so compiling stays manual. High: the index gathers the right pages and the secretary only checks identity. A page for the wrong patient is still excluded by a person.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule tests and procedures from the physician's orders.

steps.what: Read physician orders for the tests or procedures.

loop.output: Test or procedure, timing and preparation constraints
loop.check: Secretary checks each line against the order
loop.stop: One pass; a missing test name is not booked

steps.what: Check preparation constraints against that order.
Book the department slot that meets the timing.
Tell the patient the time and the preparation.
Send the preparation sheet for the booked test.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} books a department slot only after the secretary has checked the order's timing and preparation constraints. The secretary tells the patient, and the preparation sheet for that booking is sent afterwards. Native department diaries are tested before custom code. This is not a patient-facing bot.
tasks.previous_blocker: The secretary read the order, phoned the department and wrote the preparation by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Department diaries and preparation rules can book a standard test. A conflicting order is still a person.
tasks.still_hard: Orders that name two tests with incompatible preparation, and departments with no live diary.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary sees that this order should not be booked on the rule.

ambition.what: The secretary decides, when the order arrives, whether it can be booked on the department diary or must go back to the physician.

tasks.altitude: Patient calls stay on the week. The secretary can refuse a slot that breaks the preparation constraint.

reach.role: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
reach.task: Book a service the guest asked for against a department diary
reach.learn: How they refuse a time the department cannot do

evidence.claim: Department diaries and preparation rules can book a standard test. The patient is still told by a person.
A preparation sheet that names the test is health data under GDPR article 9.
A patient-facing booking bot would have to say it is AI. This design does not add one.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary. Boundary: from a physician order for a test or procedure to a booked slot and a preparation sheet. This is not the wider job of negotiating a surgical date with the patient.

Structured fields are test code, timing window and preparation code. The physician writes the order. The department maintains the diary and the preparation code. Fallback: a missing test name is not booked.
Test native {CALENDAR} resources before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers preparation codes and department resources.
unknowns: Whether each department diary is bookable from the secretary's screen.
Which tests have a written preparation code.
research_questions: What share of orders conflicts with the preparation rule?

incremental.description: Update preparation codes and department resources

approvals.approved_version: preparation sheet for the slot the secretary told the patient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: orders are handwritten and diaries are not bookable, so the secretary still phones the department. High: standard tests book from the rule and the patient call stays. The call is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare speeches, articles and correspondence with physicians.

steps.what: Assist physicians with speeches, articles or conference proceedings.
Collect the figures and sources the brief names.
Draft the correspondence, speech or article from the brief.

loop.input: The brief notes and the named sources
loop.output: A draft that cites only those sources
loop.check: Secretary checks each citation points at the named source
loop.stop: One draft; a citation that is not in the pack is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The piece follows this brief, and a citation cannot be invented

steps.what: Edit the substance of the draft.
Apply the edits and send the approved version.

tasks.design: The secretary takes the physician's brief and gathers only the sources it names. A draft is prepared from that pack, citations that are not in the pack are removed, and the physician edits the substance. The secretary applies those edits and sends that version. Native templates are tested first.
tasks.previous_blocker: The secretary wrote from a conversation and checked citations by hunting the physician's files.
tasks.enabler_now: A named source pack can start a draft. The physician still owns the substance, and invented citations are a known failure mode.
tasks.still_hard: Briefs that change halfway, and talks that have no prior text.
tasks.human_edge: The secretary knows when a sentence is the physician's point and when it is padding.
tasks.altitude: Drafting help does not move the byline. The secretary can refuse to send a version the physician has not edited.

reach.task: Find the sources a writer named
reach.learn: How they stop when a named source is not on the shelf

evidence.claim: A civil-service trial found mean drafting time fell, and staff saw invented text. Scheduling in that trial took longer. This was not a clinic.
If the piece contains a patient's data, that data is special-category data under GDPR article 9 and must not go into a free chatbot.

assumptions: Focal role is the medical secretary assisting the physician. Boundary: from a brief to a version the physician has edited. The scientific claim is the physician's.
Structured fields are title, audience, due date and the source identifiers the brief names. The physician produces the brief. Fallback: a missing source is left as a gap, not filled.
Test native {DOCS} templates before custom code. A citation that is not in the pack is deleted.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers house style. Physician edit time is already in that step.
unknowns: Whether physicians already keep a source list the secretary can open.
Whether patient stories appear in these talks.
research_questions: What share of these pieces is a repeat letter rather than a new article?

already_counted.description: Editing the draft against the pack

incremental.description: Keep the house style for letters and talks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the brief is vague and sources are missing, so the draft is rewritten, and invented text is the failure the civil-service trial already saw. High: a clear brief shortens the first draft only. The physician's edit is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still the phone, the front door and the desk. Standard bookings, bills and chart packs are ready to check. The secretary can refuse to file or send a record that failed the identity or recipient check.
reach: Eligibility interviewers: which intake questions must be asked aloud
Court clerks: which identity check they require before a copy leaves
Hotel desk clerks: how a busy desk looks up a name without losing the queue
skills_to_grow: Reading a clinical term before it is filed
Maintaining a booking rule and a prep line
Spotting a result that must be phoned, not routed
role.ambitious_version: Every result has an owner, every disclosure names the recipient, and no chart line is filed before a person has read it.
